items.source: Factory method to create a new AnnotationMetadata instance for the given class using standard reflection.
items.translation: 用于通过标准反射为给定类创建新的AnnotationMetadata实例的工厂方法。

items.source: annotationName - the fully-qualified class name of the annotation type to look for
items.translation: annotationName - 要查找的注解的完全限定类名

items.source: For any returned method, AnnotatedTypeMetadata.isAnnotated(String) will return true for the given annotation type.
items.translation: 对于任何返回的方法，AnnotatedTypeMetadata.isAnnotated(String) 将针对给定的注解类型返回 true。

items.source: Get the fully-qualified class names of all annotation types that are directly present on the underlying class.
items.translation: 获取底层类上直接存在的所有注解类型的完全限定类名。

items.source: Get the fully-qualified class names of all meta-annotation types that are present on the given annotation type on the underlying class.
items.translation: 获取底层类上给定注解类型存在的元注解类型的完全限定类名。

items.source: Determine whether an annotation of the given type is directly present on the underlying class.
items.translation: 确定给定类型的注解是否<u>直接存在</u>于底层类上。

items.source:
Retrieve the method metadata for all user-declared methods on the
underlying class, preserving declaration order as far as possible.
items.translation: 检索底层类上所有用户声明方法的方法元数据，尽可能保留声明顺序。

items.source:
Determine whether the underlying class has any methods that are
annotated (or meta-annotated) with the given annotation type.
items.translation: 确定底层类是否有任何方法被给定注解类型（或元注解）标注。

items.source:
Determine whether the underlying class has an annotation that is itself
annotated with the meta-annotation of the given type.
items.translation: 确定底层类是否具有由给定类型的元注解所注解的注解。

items.source: a set of MethodMetadata for methods that have a matching annotation. The return value will be an empty set if no methods match the annotation type.
items.translation: 一组MethodMetadata，对应具有匹配注解的方法。如果没有方法匹配该注解类型，则返回空集。

items.source: a set of MethodMetadata
items.translation: 一组MethodMetadata

items.source: a new AnnotationMetadata instance
items.translation: 一个新的AnnotationMetadata 实例

items.source: annotationName - the fully-qualified class name of the annotation type to look for meta-annotations on
items.translation: annotationName - 要查找元注解的注解的全限定类名

items.source: true if a matching annotation is directly present
items.translation: true 如果存在直接匹配的注解

items.source: metaAnnotationName - the fully-qualified class name of the meta-annotation type to look for
items.translation: `metaAnnotationName` - 要查找的元注解类型的完全限定类名

items.source: type - the class to introspect
items.translation: type - 要检查的类

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Mark Fisher, Phillip Webb, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Jürgen Höller, Mark Fisher, Phillip Webb, Sam Brannen

items.source: the annotation type names
items.translation: 注解类型名称

items.source: the meta-annotation type names, or an empty set if none found
items.translation: 元注解类型名称，或者如果未找到则为空集。

items.source:
Interface that defines abstract access to the annotations of a specific
class, in a form that does not require that class to be loaded yet.
items.translation: 定义了对特定类注解的抽象访问接口的接口，其形式不要求该类已加载。

items.source:
Retrieve the method metadata for all methods that are annotated
(or meta-annotated) with the given annotation type.
items.translation: 检索所有使用给定注解类型（或元注解）标注的方法的方法元数据。

items.source: true if a matching meta-annotation is present
items.translation: true 如果存在匹配的元注解
